citations.assessment: Rabbi Yitzchak ben Elazar calls Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Timi and Rabbi Burki a holy congregation. The Tima form belongs to Heilprin.
This chapter separately names Rabbi Burki speaking before Rabbi Mana on worship of hills. The exact holy-congregation clause is established in the Kohelet parallel.

notes.text: Burki raises an objection before Rabbi Mana in the conditional-betrothal case.
Rabbi Yitzchak ben Elazar calls Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Timi and Rabbi Burki a holy congregation. The Tima form belongs to Heilprin.
This chapter separately names Rabbi Burki speaking before Rabbi Mana on worship of hills. The exact holy-congregation clause is established in the Kohelet parallel.
The reciprocal entry identifies the same two figures and preserves the Timi form.
The checked wording is Rabbi Burkai in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, concerning the remainder of the blood.
